extension.name: mod_splaskscore
extension.author: Muhammad Azizan Hazim
extension.description: Module to display SPLaSK Score in Joomla Admin Dashboard (Logik, label gred, and adaptive presets versi 1.2.7)

field.name: splask_token
field.label: SPLaSK Token
field.description: Masukkan token SPLaSK anda untuk paparan markah.

field.name: design_preset
field.label: Design Preset
field.description: Pilih reka bentuk paparan markah SPLaSK.

field.name: appearance_mode
field.label: Appearance Mode
field.description: Pilih mod paparan: cerah, gelap, atau automatik mengikut tema pentadbir/peranti.

field.name: analytics_scheduler_note
field.label: Automation Operational Note
field.description: Automated analytics collection depends on Joomla Scheduled Tasks being active in the hosting environment. The module manages the task configuration, but the hosting cron/Scheduled Tasks runner must execute Joomla Scheduled Tasks for guaranteed automated collection.

field.name: analytics_multi_module_note
field.label: Multi-Module Scheduler Note
field.description: SPLaSK Score uses one shared Joomla Scheduled Task. Runtime collection processes every published enabled module instance, while install/upgrade bootstrap synchronizes the first/latest published instance and later module saves let the last-saved instance control the shared schedule.

field.name: analytics_auto_enabled
field.label: Enable Automatic Analytics Collection
field.description: Automatically keep the Joomla Scheduled Task synchronized from this module's settings. The Joomla Scheduled Tasks runner must be operational in the hosting environment for guaranteed automated collection.

field.name: analytics_frequency
field.label: Collection Frequency
field.description: How often the managed scheduler task should collect analytics when Joomla Scheduled Tasks are running.

field.name: analytics_collection_time
field.label: Collection Time
field.description: Daily collection time used by the managed scheduler task when Joomla Scheduled Tasks are running.

field.name: analytics_duplicate_cooldown
field.label: Duplicate Cooldown (minutes)
field.description: Minimum interval before identical analytics snapshots can be stored again.

field.name: analytics_retention_days
field.label: Analytics Retention (days)
field.description: Automatically prune analytics records older than this number of days.

field.name: analytics_max_rows
field.label: Maximum History Rows
field.description: Maximum analytics records retained per module/token pair after pruning.

field.name: analytics_scheduler_status
field.label: Scheduler Status
field.description: Read-only status of the SPLaSK managed Joomla Scheduled Task after the last module save. This does not replace the hosting requirement for an active Joomla Scheduled Tasks runner.

field.name: analytics_last_successful_collection
field.label: Last Successful Collection
field.description: Read-only timestamp from the latest analytics health record known to this module.
